left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients with mild-to-moderate idiopathic CTS with clinical manifestations failed to respond to conservative treatment  [AND] ( such as splint, [OR]  medications, [OR]  Physical therapy) for at least 3 months and they were diagnosed by electrophysiological study  [OR] and musculoskeletal ultrasound

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Diabetes
  -  Hypothyroidism
  -  Rheumatoid arthritis
  -  Previous carpal tunnel decompressive surgery
  -  Cervical radiculopathy, [OR]  polyneuropathy, [OR]  brachial plexopathy, [OR]  traumatic nerve injury, [OR]  thoracic outlet syndrome
  -  Previous corticosteroid injection into the carpal tunnel in the preceding 4 weeks
  -  Anemia (hemoglobin <10gm%)
  -  Coagulopathy
  -  Pregnancy
